races.name: Demon
races.description: Hailing from the infernal planes beyond the mortal veil, demons are creatures of pure elemental chaos. Each demon embodies a primal force ÔÇö fire demons burn with endless rage, shadow demons hunger for fear and despair. They enter the mortal world through rifts and summonings, bringing destruction in their wake. Yet some demons reject their nature, seeking redemption in a world that fears and despises them.

races.name: Dwarf
races.description: Forged from the bones of the earth itself, dwarves are as stubborn as the mountains they call home. Their kingdoms stretch deep beneath the peaks, where they mine mithril and carve halls of breathtaking beauty. Dwarven smiths are unmatched in the mortal realm, and their resistance to magic makes them feared opponents. A dwarf's word is their bond, and their grudges are recorded in stone to last ten generations.

races.name: Elf
races.description: Born from the tears of the Moon goddess, the elves are the eldest of the mortal races. Their connection to magic runs in their blood, granting them innate resistance to spells and a grace that other races find unsettling. High Elves study the arcane arts in crystal towers, Dark Elves weave shadows in the underdark, and Forest Elves move as whispers through the ancient woods. Elves measure time in centuries and rarely hurry.

races.name: Halfling
races.description: The smallest of the civilized races, halflings possess a spirit that belies their stature. They believe in the power of luck, good food, and a warm hearth, yet they are among the bravest souls in battle. Halflings feel fear but refuse to show it, using their natural agility and sharp tongues to mock and taunt enemies into reckless charges. Forest Halflings move through woodland without a trace, while Hill Halflings are renowned for their hospitality and uncanny good fortune.

races.name: Human
races.description: The children of the All-Father, humans are the most adaptable of the mortal races. From the barbarian hordes of the Frozen Wastes to the merchant princes of Eldergard, humanity's ambition knows no bounds. Their settlements dot every corner of the realm, and their short lives burn twice as bright as the long-lived elves. No other race can match their versatility ÔÇö a human may rise from peasant to king in a single lifetime.

races.name: Kobold
races.description: Small, scaly, and underestimated by every other race, kobolds are survivors. They dwell in the cracks of the world ÔÇö forgotten mines, sewer networks, and the underbellies of great cities. Their natural cunning and magic resistance have kept them alive against larger, stronger foes. A kobold's greatest weapon is not their claw or fang, but their cleverness. They build traps that would impress dwarves and tunnels that baffle even elves.

races.name: Lizard
races.description: Scales shimmering like gemstones, the lizardfolk are the Silent Children of the Sun. They are descendants of the lesser dragons, evolved from those ancient bloodlines when the world was young. The draconic heritage runs deep in their veins ÔÇö their scales, their resilience, their cold patience all echo the great wyrms. To outsiders they seem emotionless, but among their own kind they share deep bonds of loyalty. Swamp Lizards glide through poisonous marshes, Desert Lizards endure the searing heat, and Forest Lizards strike from the canopy with terrifying precision.

races.name: Ogre
races.description: Titans reduced by ages of separation from their divine ancestors, ogres are the largest of the mortal races. Standing twelve feet tall and built of solid muscle and thick bone, they are living battering rams. Mountain Ogres possess residual magic resistance from their giant bloodline, Hill Ogres throw boulders with deadly accuracy, Desert Ogres endure the harshest climates, and Forest Ogres can regenerate wounds at an alarming rate.

races.name: Orc
races.description: The Chosen of the War God, orcs were created to fight. Their muscles bulge with unnatural strength, and their bones knit faster than any other race. Orc society is built around the concept of 'Ushog' ÔÇö the eternal struggle that gives life meaning. They value strength above all else and respect only those who can defeat them in battle. Despite their savage reputation, orcish honor is absolute; an orc who gives their word will die before breaking it.

races.name: Undead
races.description: Not a race but a condition ÔÇö souls that refused the call of the afterlife. Undead cannot be played as characters; they exist only as NPCs and monsters encountered in the world. Bound to their rotting bodies by sheer will or necromantic curse, they walk the mortal plane seeking purpose, vengeance, or redemption. Immune to fear and pain, they feel only the cold hunger of their existence. Some serve dark masters; others wander as lone penitents, searching for a peace that will not come.

weapons.name: Dragon's Fury
weapons.description: A flaming battle axe forged from the fang of the Great Wyrm Igneel. The blade burns eternally, and its wounds cauterize as they are made. +2 attack bonus.

weapons.name: Frostbite
weapons.description: A short sword blessed by the Frost Queen of the Northern Wastes. Eternal ice coats the blade, slowing victims and leaving frozen wounds. +2 attack bonus.

weapons.name: Shadow Sting
weapons.description: A dagger that exists partly in the material plane and partly in the Shadowfell. It phases through armor to strike the soul directly. +2 attack bonus.

weapons.name: Soul Prison
weapons.description: A mace forged from the bars of a broken cage that held a hundred souls. It hits like an avalanche and traps a fragment of each victim's spirit, but the trapped souls scream constantly in the wielder's mind.

weapons.name: Soul Reaver
weapons.description: A massive black blade forged in the Abyss from a dying star. It drinks the souls of the fallen and whispers their final screams to its wielder. +3 attack bonus.

weapons.name: Stormbringer
weapons.description: A crackling lance charged with the fury of a primordial storm. When the wielder charges, thunder shakes the earth and lightning arcs from the tip. +2 attack bonus.

weapons.name: Sun's Wrath
weapons.description: A morning star that glows with the light of dawn. Forged by the priests of the Sun God, it sears the undead and burns away darkness. +2 attack bonus.

weapons.name: Blood Drinker
weapons.description: A long sword with a red vein running through the steel. It hungers for blood and grants its wielder unnatural strength, but it feeds on the wielder's life force with every swing.

weapons.name: Bone Crusher
weapons.description: A brutal mace carved from the femur of a hill giant by the shaman of the Thunder Ridge tribe. It shatters armor and bone into dust. The handle is wrapped in the hide of the shaman's first kill.

weapons.name: Viper Fang
weapons.description: A curved assassin's dagger coated in a venom that never dries. The fang of the great serpent Sythiss was hollowed and set into a hilt of obsidian.

weapons.name: Wind Cutter
weapons.description: A slender long sword balanced to perfection. Forged by the wind elf smith Aeloril, who spent a century shaping its edge. It sings as it cuts through air.

weapons.name: Witchwood Staff
weapons.description: A gnarled staff of living black wood that writhes in the hand. It amplifies dark magic but slowly poisons the user's mind with whispers from the void.

weapons.name: Barrow Bow
weapons.description: A short bow carved from the root of a tree that grew through an ancient barrow. The wood remembers the dead and guides arrows toward the vital spots of the living.

weapons.name: Oathkeeper
weapons.description: A blade broken and reforged three times, each by a different smith across three generations. Its current form is simple, unbreakable, and sharp ÔÇö much like the oath it was forged to represent.

weapons.name: Serpent's Fang
weapons.description: A spear tipped with the fang of the World Serpent. Venom drips eternally from the tip. It is deadly to enemies ÔÇö and occasionally to its wielder.

weapons.name: The Last Argument
weapons.description: A morning star forged from the chains of a slave galley by a freed prisoner named Harvoth. Each of the six spikes represents a year of servitude. Harvoth vowed it would be his last argument in any dispute.

weapons.name: Wolf's Bane
weapons.description: A spear originally crafted by the ranger Aldric to hunt the dire wolves that terrorized his village. The shaft is wrapped in silver wire and the obsidian tip has never dulled. It has claimed the lives of seven alpha wolves.

weapons.name: Father's Mercy
weapons.description: A well-worn long sword passed down through five generations of the Samek family. The leather grip is molded to the hand of the original owner, and the blade bears the scratches of a hundred battles. It may not be magical, but it has never let its wielder down.

weapons.name: Final Toll
weapons.description: A hand axe carried by the bell-ringer of the Temple of Passing. He used it to defend the temple during the Sack of Eldergard. The axe still rings like a bell when it strikes.

weapons.name: Battle Axe
weapons.description: Forged for the line-breakers of the Iron Company. Each swing carries the weight of a hundred battles fought in the mountain passes.

weapons.name: Dagger
weapons.description: Small enough to hide in a boot or up a sleeve. Every adventurer carries one, and every assassin has used one.

weapons.name: Great Sword
weapons.description: A towering blade requiring both hands and the strength of three men. Favored by executioners and elite shock troops of the Crimson Legion.

weapons.name: Hand Axe
weapons.description: A weathered throwing axe passed down through generations of border scouts. The leather grip bears the brand of the Northern Watch.

weapons.name: Heavy Crossbow
weapons.description: A miniature siege engine. Its bolts punch through plate armor at two hundred paces. Requires a crank and steady nerves.

weapons.name: Lance
weapons.description: The thunder of a cavalry charge is the sound of lances lowering. Few things in battle match the terror of knights at full gallop.

weapons.name: Light Crossbow
weapons.description: A mechanical bow that can be fired one-handed while prone. The favored tool of tunnel fighters and castle defenders.

weapons.name: Long Bow
weapons.description: The signature weapon of the Eldergard Rangers. Its range and stopping power are whispered about in every tavern from here to the coast.

weapons.name: Long Sword
weapons.description: The knight's companion. Balanced for cut and thrust, this blade has been the weapon of warriors across every kingdom for a thousand years.

weapons.name: Mace
weapons.description: The simplest of weapons ÔÇö a weighted head on a wooden shaft. It crushes armor where a blade would turn aside.

weapons.name: Maul
weapons.description: A weapon that does not cut or pierce ÔÇö it simply destroys whatever it hits. The tool of temple guardians and ogre-killers.

weapons.name: Morning Star
weapons.description: A spiked iron ball on a short chain. Once carried by the cavalry of the fallen Kingdom of Ashvale before its fall to the demon horde.

weapons.name: Quarter Staff
weapons.description: A length of hardened ironwood favored by travelers, monks, and those who prefer discretion over steel.

weapons.name: Short Bow
weapons.description: A curved bow carved from yew and horn by the bowyers of the Green Valley. Hunters across the realm rely on its steady pull.

weapons.name: Short Sword
weapons.description: The preferred blade of city guards and sellswords. Quick, reliable, and easy to maintain in the field.

weapons.name: Spear
weapons.description: The oldest weapon of mortal kind. Easy to learn, hard to master, deadly in disciplined formation.

weapons.name: Wand
weapons.description: A slender focus rod of enchanted elm. Its tip glows faintly when magic surges through it. Used by hedge wizards and court mages alike.

weapons.name: War Hammer
weapons.description: Its head forged in the shape of a ram's skull by the smiths of the Stonepeak clan. Each blow lands like a battering ram against fortifications.

armor.name: Dragon Scale Mail
armor.description: Armor woven from hundreds of indestructible dragon scales from the Great Wyrm Igneel. The scales still retain their fire resistance.

armor.name: Shadow Cloak
armor.description: A cloak woven from the fabric of twilight itself. It drifts and shifts of its own accord, causing enemy attacks to miss at the last instant.

armor.name: Titan Plate
armor.description: Colossal plate forged in the heart of Mount Kryx by ancient giant smiths. It could withstand a direct hit from a god's hammer. +2 AC.

armor.name: Binding Chains
armor.description: Chain mail forged from the actual chains of a prison ship that sank with a hundred souls aboard. The damned still cling to it, dragging on the wearer. Grants protection but weighs on the spirit.

armor.name: Knight's Honor
armor.description: Ceremonial splint armor blessed by the priests of Heaven. Its enameled surface depicts the Battle of the Silver Plains in exquisite detail.

armor.name: Mithril Chain
armor.description: A shimmering chain shirt forged from mithril, the lightest metal known to dwarven craft. It flows like silk but protects like steel.

armor.name: Forest Warden's Coat
armor.description: Studded leather grown from a living treant sapling by the druids of the Deepwood. It breathes, repairs itself over time, and never impedes movement.

armor.name: Mariner's Plate
armor.description: Rust-proof plate armor inlaid with coral from the Sunken Kingdoms. It grants the wearer the ability to breathe water and move freely underwater.

armor.name: Mask of the Betrayer
armor.description: A full helm of black steel with no eyeholes ÔÇö yet the wearer sees perfectly through it. Sometimes. The helm shows its bearer visions of their greatest betrayal at the worst possible moment.

armor.name: Watchman's Shield
armor.description: A well-worn shield with a fist-sized dent ÔÇö the result of stopping a boulder during the Siege of Ironwall. The watchman who carried it saved a dozen lives that day.

armor.name: Widow's Embrace
armor.description: A beautiful silver breastplate that once belonged to a queen who watched her entire kingdom fall. It protects the body but fills the heart with grief.

armor.name: Breastplate
armor.description: A polished steel breastplate engraved with the wearer's family crest. Favored by officers who need protection without sacrificing mobility.

armor.name: Chain Mail
armor.description: A full hauberk of interlocking rings reaching to the knees. Heavy, noisy, but nearly impervious to slashing weapons. Standard issue for the Iron Company.

armor.name: Chain Shirt
armor.description: A shirt of interlocking rings that jingles with every step. The minimum standard for any professional soldier in the Eldergard army.

armor.name: Half Plate
armor.description: Partial plate armor covering the vital areas while leaving joints exposed for mobility. A grim compromise between protection and speed.

armor.name: Hide Armor
armor.description: The stripped hide of a cave bear, crudely cured over a campfire. Primitive but effective. Worn by the barbarian tribes of the Frozen Wastes.

armor.name: Leather Armor
armor.description: Treated leather boiled in wax and shaped to the body. Worn by scouts, highwaymen, and rangers who value mobility over raw protection.

armor.name: Padded Armor
armor.description: Quilted cloth stuffed with raw wool and straw. Better than nothing, but only barely. Worn by militia conscripts and desperate peasants.

armor.name: Plate Armor
armor.description: The pinnacle of mortal armor craft. Articulated steel plates covering every inch of the body. Only knights and wealthy lords can afford it.

armor.name: Ring Mail
armor.description: Leather armor with heavy iron rings sewn across the surface. An old design still used by frontier garrisons who cannot afford better.

armor.name: Scale Mail
armor.description: Overlapping iron plates sewn onto a leather backing resembling dragon scales. Provides excellent protection against slashing attacks. Worn by dragon-hunters of the Burning Plains.

armor.name: Shield
armor.description: A wooden shield branded with the crest of the City Watch. It has stopped arrows, blades, and a charging boar. The paint is chipped from a dozen battles.

armor.name: Splint Armor
armor.description: Vertical steel strips riveted to a sturdy leather backing. An affordable alternative to full plate, favored by veteran mercenaries of the Free Companies.

armor.name: Studded Leather
armor.description: Leather reinforced with hundreds of iron rivets. A favorite among city guards who patrol the dangerous dock districts at night.

accessories.name: Amulet of the Archon
accessories.description: A golden pendant bearing the crest of the celestial realm. +2 Wisdom, +1 Holy damage.

accessories.name: Locket of Lost Souls
accessories.description: A black iron locket containing ash from the Shadowfell. +2 Intelligence, attracts undead.

accessories.name: Dragon Tooth Amulet
accessories.description: A sharp fang from a young dragon, still humming with power. +1 Strength, +1 Fire Resist.

accessories.name: Heartstone Pendant
accessories.description: A warm gem that pulses like a heartbeat. +20 Max HP, +1 Stamina.

accessories.name: Silver Cross of Hope
accessories.description: A simple silver cross that glows faintly in darkness. +1 Wisdom, Fear Resistance.

accessories.name: Cursed Girdle of Weakness
accessories.description: An ornate golden belt that feels heavy. +3 Charisma but -3 Strength (drains your power).
accessories.curse_effect: -3 Strength, -1 max HP per day worn

accessories.name: Girdle of Giant Strength
accessories.description: A thick leather belt woven from giant hair. Grants 18/00 Strength to any wearer.

accessories.name: Belt of the Ram
accessories.description: A bronze belt with a ram's head buckle. +2 Constitution, +1 Charge damage.

accessories.name: Sash of Shadows
accessories.description: A dark silk sash that blends into darkness. +1 Dexterity, +1 Stealth.

accessories.name: Iron Buckle of Vigor
accessories.description: A simple iron buckle that fortifies the body. +1 Stamina, +5 Max HP.

accessories.name: Cursed Ring of Greed
accessories.description: A glittering gold ring that feels warm to the touch. +2 Charisma but -2 Stamina from sleepless nights.

accessories.name: Ring of Shadows
accessories.description: A dark ring that drinks the light around it. +1 AC, +1 Stealth.

accessories.name: Titan Ring
accessories.description: A massive stone ring worn by giants. Grants +3 Strength.

accessories.name: Band of the Bull
accessories.description: A thick iron band etched with a charging bull. Grants +2 Strength.

accessories.name: Ring of Arcane Focus
accessories.description: A crystal ring pulsing with magical energy. Reduces spell mana cost.

accessories.name: Ring of the Fox
accessories.description: A silver ring engraved with a running fox. Grants +2 Dexterity.

accessories.name: Serpent Ring
accessories.description: A coiled jade serpent that sharpens the mind. Grants +2 Intelligence.

npcs.name: Elder Treant
npcs.biography: An ancient treant awakened by the druids of the Deepwood. He grants the Dragon Scale Mail to those who prove they can protect the forest.

npcs.name: Graveworm
npcs.biography: An undead warlord who commands a legion of skeletons in the Bone Fields. He carries Frostbite, the blade that killed him centuries ago.

npcs.name: Greta Ironhand
npcs.biography: A dwarf smith who forged weapons for three kings. She keeps the Soul Reaver hidden beneath her forge, waiting for a worthy champion. She buys and sells all weapons and armor.

npcs.name: High Priestess Luna
npcs.biography: The head of the Moon temple. She bestows the Amulet of the Archon upon those who complete the pilgrimage to the Moonlit Peak.

npcs.name: Infernal Commander Zoth
npcs.biography: A demon lord commanding the legions of the Fire Pits. He wields the Stormbringer lance and rides a nightmare steed. The final boss of the Burning Plains.

npcs.name: Korg Stonefist
npcs.biography: A wandering orc berserker who challenges all who cross his path. Wields a massive maul and wears cursed plate that feeds on his pain.

npcs.name: Lysander the Bard
npcs.biography: A halfling bard who knows every legend, song, and secret in the realm. He can reveal the location of any legendary item for a price.

npcs.name: Merchant Vex
npcs.biography: A kobold trader with a cart full of "authentic" artifacts. Most are fakes, but occasionally she comes across a real treasure. She sells rings, amulets, and girdles.

npcs.name: Old Man Kael
npcs.biography: A blind seer who speaks in riddles. He knows the location of the Sun's Wrath and will trade the knowledge for a vial of dragon's blood.

npcs.name: Shadowmere
npcs.biography: The leader of the Nightblades guild. She offers membership to those who prove their worth by retrieving the Shadow Sting from the Crypt of Whispers.

spells.name: Acid Rain
spells.description: Corrosive rain burns all in the area.

spells.name: Blade Barrier
spells.description: A wall of spinning blades.

spells.name: Blind
spells.description: Robs the target of sight.

spells.name: Blinding Flash
spells.description: A brilliant flash blinds all who see it.

spells.name: Blizzard
spells.description: Freezing winds and snow pelt the area.

spells.name: Charm Enemy
spells.description: Bends an enemy to your will.

spells.name: Confuse
spells.description: Makes the target act erratically.

spells.name: Earthquake
spells.description: The ground shakes violently.

spells.name: Fear
spells.description: Instills overwhelming terror.

spells.name: Fire Storm
spells.description: A conflagration engulfs the area.

spells.name: Fog of Despair
spells.description: A choking fog that saps morale.

spells.name: Freeze
spells.description: Encases the target in ice.

spells.name: Ice Storm
spells.description: Hail and ice pummel the area.

spells.name: Insect Swarm
spells.description: A cloud of biting insects descends.

spells.name: Lava Hail
spells.description: Molten rock rains from the sky.

spells.name: Lightning Strike
spells.description: A bolt of lightning strikes from above.

spells.name: Provoke
spells.description: Enrages the target, reducing its defenses.

spells.name: Root
spells.description: Anchors the target to the ground.

spells.name: Sacrifice
spells.description: Sacrifice own HP to empower an ally.

spells.name: Sand Storm
spells.description: Blinding sand scours the battlefield.

spells.name: Sleep
spells.description: Puts the target into a magical slumber.

spells.name: Stun
spells.description: A concussive force that stuns the target.

spells.name: Summon Creature
spells.description: Calls a creature to fight for you.

spells.name: Taunt
spells.description: Forces an enemy to attack you.

classes.name: Barbarian
classes.description: Fierce warriors who channel rage into devastating attacks.

classes.name: Bard
classes.description: Musicians and storytellers who weave magic through performance.

classes.name: Druid
classes.description: Guardians of nature who command the elements and beasts.

classes.name: Fighter
classes.description: Weapons masters trained in all forms of combat.

classes.name: Knight
classes.description: Armored cavaliers and champions of noble causes.

classes.name: Mage
classes.description: Masters of the arcane who wield devastating spells.

classes.name: Paladin
classes.description: Holy warriors blessed by the gods with divine power.

classes.name: Priest
classes.description: Devoted servants who channel divine magic to heal and protect.

classes.name: Rogue
classes.description: Cunning infiltrators who strike from the shadows.

item_sets.name: Dragonborn Legacy
item_sets.description: Armor and weapons crafted from the remains of the Great Wyrm Igneel. Provides fire resistance and fury.

item_sets.name: Iron Sentinel
item_sets.description: A sturdy set of forged iron armor worn by the city watch of Eldergard. Grants unparalleled defense when worn together.

item_sets.name: Shadow Stalker
item_sets.description: Dark leather and chain worn by the Nightblades of the undercity. Enhances speed and stealth.

deities.name: Constellations
deities.description: The woven patterns of destiny in the night sky.

deities.name: Darkness
deities.description: The void from which all shadows are born.

deities.name: Fire
deities.description: The consuming flame of destruction and rebirth.

deities.name: Heaven
deities.description: The celestial realm of pure light and order.

deities.name: Moon
deities.description: The silver orb that governs tides and magic.

deities.name: Shadow
deities.description: The realm between light and dark, home to assassins.

deities.name: Smoke
deities.description: The veil of deception and obscured truths.

deities.name: Star
deities.description: The guiding stars that illuminate fate.
